Heightens delisting risk, a key stock overhang and liquidity threat.
Removes the specific filing lapse, but prior delisting basis remains.
Nasdaq cited discretionary concerns tied to potential misconduct.

This is a late-stage escalation of listing compliance issues after a prior August delisting notice; the late 20-F filing reduces one technical breach but not the broader risk. A clear Nasdaq panel outcome or withdrawal of delisting proceedings would be the catalyst; otherwise, suspension/delisting would be.
